tsm.description: 22,815 GeoJSON screening footprints versus 23,082 archived IGIO-labeled identities. The root OGC tileset points to a smaller independent renderable LiDAR mesh subset; neither layer is survey-grade or regulatory evidence.
tsm.coverageBasis: GeoJSON feature counts only; archived OBJECTID delta is separately pinned. Renderable mesh coverage, original source authority, NAVD88/ellipsoid transformation, and scientific acceptance are not established by this file.
